name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets are built to your exact specifications, offering unlimited choices in size, shape, materials, finishes, and features to fit any kitchen layout perfectly. Semi-custom cabinets come in a wider range of sizes, styles, and finishes than stock options, allowing for some modifications to height, depth, or width, and more accessories. Custom offers ultimate personalization, while semi-custom provides a balance of flexibility and cost-effectiveness for many remodels.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are fully bespoke, built to exact specifications, while semi-custom cabinets offer more options than stock but with some size and style limitations.
